About DanKen Industries

DanKen Industries is an early-stage product manufacturing startup focused on building a cross-border sourcing, manufacturing, and U.S. distribution model.

Our primary focus is luxury furniture, smart furniture, and mechanized furniture, including beds, smart beds, sofas, sectionals, electric recliners, mattresses, smart bedroom sets, home theater seating, and commercial/hospitality furniture.

Furniture features may include electric recline, Bluetooth speakers, USB/Type-C charging, wireless charging, LED lighting, touch controls, fireplaces, TV lifts, adjustable mechanisms, power motion, and other smart components.

We are also evaluating secondary product categories, including custom 4-seat and 6-seat electric golf carts, golf cart parts/accessories, wheels, rims, tires, and related aftermarket or private-label opportunities. Furniture remains the main priority, but these secondary categories are part of the long-term operating platform.

Our intended model may include:

- China/global sourcing for components, mechanisms, electronics, golf cart parts, wheels, rims, tires, and raw materials
- Dominican Republic toll manufacturing, assembly, fabrication support, and possible final production
- U.S. sales, distribution, compliance, customer delivery, and market expansion

Role Overview

We are seeking a hands-on Fractional President / COO to help build, structure, and execute DanKen Industries from the startup stage into scalable operations.

This is not a passive advisory role. We need a founder’s right-hand operating partner who can help turn product ideas, sourcing opportunities, supplier relationships, manufacturing plans, sales channels, and execution priorities into a structured operating business.

The right candidate should be comfortable wearing multiple hats across operations, sourcing, supply chain, logistics, product development coordination, toll manufacturing, cost control, sales development, project management, workflows, dashboards, SOPs, reporting, and accountability.

- Building cost models, unit economics, BOM review, target cost tracking, margin protection, and cost-reduction plans
- Helping identify and onboard future specialists, vendors, contractors, sourcing support, QC support, and production managers

Initial Phase Objective

DanKen Industries is still in the early startup planning and development stage. We do not yet have a finalized execution plan in place.

The purpose of this role is to help us build that plan from the ground up.

The selected candidate should help turn our current business vision, product categories, sourcing ideas, manufacturing concepts, and sales goals into a clear execution roadmap.

The initial phase may include:

- Reviewing the business concept, product categories, and startup goals
- Developing the first real execution roadmap

- Defining sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and sales-development strategy
- Determining the best path toward samples, supplier validation, and production readiness
- Recommending needed specialists, vendors, engineers, sourcing agents, logistics support, and contractors
- Organizing workflows, reporting, project tracking, and accountability

We are not looking for someone to simply follow a prebuilt plan. We need someone who can help build the plan, validate the strategy, organize execution, and prepare the business for samples and initial production.

Ideal Candidate

Strong preference for someone with experience in several of the following:

- Fractional President, COO, General Manager, Operating Partner, or similar leadership role

- Furniture, smart furniture, motion furniture, electric recliners, adjustable beds, mattresses, sofas, sectionals, or home furnishings

- OEM/private-label product development
- China sourcing, RFQs, supplier vetting, and factory coordination

- Dealer, distributor, B2B, retail, hospitality, commercial, wholesale, or sales channel development
- Cost reduction, BOM review, unit economics, dashboards, SOPs, workflows, and accountability systems

Compensation

This is a new startup and the role will be virtual/remote-based starting out, so initial base compensation will be limited in the beginning. However, we are open to building a fair structure that rewards execution and results.

We are looking for someone who understands early-stage startup realities and is open to a structure that balances limited starting compensation with bonus upsides.

To Apply

- Relevant experience and examples of businesses or operations you helped build or scale
- Experience with furniture, smart furniture, golf carts, wheels/rims/tires, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, or product-based businesses
- Experience with electrical, mechanized, or technology-integrated products
- How you would approach creating the first-phase execution plan
- How you would help us get organized for supplier validation, samples, and early production
- Proposed deliverables
- Preferred compensation structure

We are looking for someone practical, hands-on, execution-focused, and capable of helping build DanKen Industries from idea → structure → sourcing → samples → production → sales → scale.

Best regards,
Daniel
DanKen Industries

projects.title: Kartra Printify E-commerce Store Setup
projects.full_description:
I want a fully-functioning print-on-demand "curated collection" store 
built inside Kartra and wired to Printify through Zapier (or another 
reliable connector). The first collection will act as the master 
template, so every element needs to be modular, clearly named, and 
simple to duplicate for future collections.

Core pages I need live from day one are:
- A conversion-focused homepage that introduces the collection and 
 funnels visitors to products
- Product detail pages that pull variant data from Printify and push 
 orders back seamlessly
- Checkout and thank-you pages fully styled inside Kartra
- Email list opt-in blocks plus a basic follow-up sequence
- Catalog page (manually curated collector's archive — see 
 Clarifications entry below for details) [UPDATED]
[REMOVED GIVEAWAYS]

I lean toward a bold look—crisp typography, confident color, plenty 
of white space—yet still modern and ultra-usable. If you have 
minimalist tendencies that support clarity, that's welcome so long as 
the end result feels charming and energetic.

Technical must-haves
- Kartra + Printify integration tested end-to-end 
 (order → fulfillment → status update)
- Zapier (or equivalent) handling any data bridges that Kartra's 
 native tools can't cover
- Simple tagging strategy for customers, products, and campaigns that 
 will scale as the catalog grows
- Variant selectors on product detail pages (size, color, etc.) must 
 render dynamically based on whatever options Printify provides for 
 each product, not assume fixed dimension names or a fixed number of 
 selectors. A single-variant product shows no selector; a product 
 with one variant dimension shows one selector; a product with 
 multiple dimensions shows multiple, all driven entirely by 
 Printify's data. Adding or changing variants for any product should 
 require no changes to the Kartra template, only the Printify-side 
 product configuration.
- Zapier architecture is specified: per-collection Zaps only, 
 Kartra-native automation for abandoned cart and post-purchase email 
 sequence, bidirectional stock sync, filters before action steps. 
 See our Clarifications entry below for full Zap architecture 
 requirements. [NEW]
- Out-of-stock and discontinued Printify products display as Sold Out 
 on their Kartra page, remain visible. Availability sync must be 
 bidirectional: out-of-stock AND back-in-stock events both update 
 Kartra automatically. [NEW]

Deliverables
1. Complete page set above, mobile-first and branded to the style 
 guide we confirm together
2. Reusable section blocks (headers, footers, product grids, opt-ins) 
 with logical naming conventions
3. Step-by-step documentation so a non-developer can duplicate the 
 funnel, swap graphics, and launch another collection in minutes
4. Quick video or screen-share walkthrough of the finished workspace

Acceptance criteria: a test product must be purchasable end-to-end, 
trigger the correct Printify order, apply the assigned tags in Kartra, 
and drop the buyer into the initial email sequence without errors.

If you're fluent in Kartra page builder, understand POD workflows, 
and can explain your build clearly, let's talk timing and next steps. 
[References required].

UPDATE: I will be reviewing and responding during the next couple of 
days. PLEASE READ CONSOLIDATED CLARIFICATIONS BEFORE ADDING NEW 
QUESTIONS. Thank you!

CONSOLIDATED CLARIFICATIONS
(Summarizes and supersedes the scattered Q&A below where there's 
overlap)

CURRENT SETUP STATUS
- Kartra (Starter plan) and Printify accounts: established. This build
 uses a dedicated Printify store, separate from our existing
 Etsy-connected Printify stores.
- Zapier: not yet set up, will be configured before/at the start of
 this engagement.
- Printify catalog for this collection: ~30 products, already created
 and live (blueprints, variants, pricing, mockups configured).
 Category: drinkware. Most products have no variants; two have
 variants intentionally (one single-dimension, e.g. size-only; one
 with both size and color) to validate variant handling against real
 data.
- Branding: a color palette and brand guide exist, shared with whoever
 is selected, not during bidding. General direction: bold, crisp
 typography, confident color, white space, charming/energetic. Copy
 is supplied by us.
- Shipping: US addresses only, checkout should restrict to US shipping
 addresses.
- Payment: Stripe live now; PayPal possibly added before/during build.

DATA ARCHITECTURE
- Printify is the single source of truth for pricing, variant options,
 and availability, kept in sync via automation.
- Availability sync must be bidirectional: out-of-stock AND 
 back-in-stock events both update Kartra automatically without manual 
 intervention. Both directions must be explicitly wired. [NEW]
- Titles, descriptions, and primary images on Kartra pages are our 
 own content, set during build, editable by us afterward, not 
 overwritten by Printify syncs.

VARIANT RENDERING (technical must-have)
- Variant selectors must render dynamically based on whatever options
 Printify provides per product: no selector for single-variant
 products, one selector for one dimension, multiple for multiple
 dimensions. Adding/changing variants should only require a
 Printify-side change, never a template change.

INTEGRATION & AUTOMATION
- Kartra is the full storefront/checkout; Printify is 
 fulfillment-only, customers never interact with it directly.
- Zapier is our required integration tool (not [login to view URL], not custom
 API/webhooks): established platform, native Kartra support, widest
 documentation and support pool, no developer-maintained code.
- Order flow: Kartra checkout -> Zapier -> Printify order creation ->
 status sync back to Kartra.
- Fulfillment status needed: shipment/tracking only. On shipment, 
 update customer tag AND trigger separate transactional 
 shipping/tracking email.
- If any Zap step fails, send notification to a specified email (email address will be provided at engagement start).
- Full Zap architecture requirements: see our Clarifications entry 
 below. [NEW]

TAGGING
- We have an existing naming convention (prefix-based, human-readable
 SKUs). Developer proposes tag categories/structure Kartra needs;
 we populate with our existing conventions. No flat/generic tagging.

EMAIL AUTOMATION
- Built entirely inside Kartra (no external ESP for this build).
- Post-purchase sequence: 4 emails, order confirmation, delivery 
 check-in (time-delayed), cross-sell/review ask, 30-day 
 similar-products. Anything beyond this is a separate future flow.
- Abandoned cart: Kartra-native automation only, follow-up email + 
 "prospect" tag. Do not use Zapier for this.

CATALOG PAGE [UPDATED]
- Manually curated, manually edited Kartra page. No dynamic data 
 connection to Printify. No automation dependency of any kind.
- Styled collector's archive: flat list of products/drops with dates,
 quantities produced or sold, and 1-2 images per item.
- Must be editable by us or a VA inside Kartra without touching any
 automation, Printify connection, or page structure.
- Do not build any dynamic or automated data feed into this page.

PRODUCT PAGES & DISCONTINUED PRODUCTS [UPDATED]
- Each product gets its own page from one reusable template.
- Out-of-stock and discontinued products: display as Sold Out, page
 remains visible. Sync is bidirectional (see Data Architecture).
- Documentation must cover removing/retiring a product page ourselves
 without developer involvement.

SCOPE CHANGE
- Giveaway page removed. Core pages: homepage, product detail pages,
 checkout/thank-you, catalog.

FUTURE COLLECTIONS / DUPLICATION
- Each future collection is its own independently-branded store,
 built by duplicating this template and swapping: connected Printify
 product(s), images, copy, tag values. No automation-logic or 
 page-structure changes needed per collection.
- Each collection has its own standalone funnel and email sequence,
 no cross-store navigation or unified customer journey.

QA & HANDOFF
- Developer fully tests every integration step and page before 
 calling the build complete.
- We run our own acceptance testing as part of delivery.
- No ongoing developer relationship planned after delivery.
 Documentation and walkthrough must be sufficient for non-developer
 duplication, edits, and product-page removal.
